_help: Edit this file on github.com to steer the weekly Instagram run. paused: true stops it. mode: 'schedule' posts automatically, 'draft' leaves every post as a draft for you to approve in Metricool. weekdays: 0=Monday ... 6=Sunday. monthly_cap: the Metricool plan limit. skip_if_ahead_days: the run does nothing if posts are already logged this many days ahead. skip_dates: dates that get no post (YYYY-MM-DD).
